content.comment_body: Hello, can anyone assist? I need to change the date format in a message text block on the display to French, for example, from 'Tu' to 'Mardi' for the day parameter, as shown in the image. Thanks, [user_name]
The display format for date and time cannot be changed to other languages. Only the English format is available.
The only solution is to create a separate text block for each day of the week. This can be done in [product_name], but it requires considerable effort.

analysis.insight_summary: Users found that the device only supports the English date and time display format, with no options for localization to other languages like French. The lack of multilingual support causes difficulties for users needing non-English formats. Workarounds are available but require manual configuration and are time-consuming.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to easily change the date and time display language, such as to French, through the device settings.
